THE PHILIPPINE DEPOSIT INSURANCE CORPORATION (PDIC), 
AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 18, 22, 24, 26 and 28

rows.title_short: Further Strengthening The Regulatory Framework For The Philippine Deposit Insurance Corporation (pdic), Amending For The Purpose Sections 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 18, 22, 24, 26 And 28 Of Republic Act No. 3591, As Amended, Otherwise Known As The Pdic Charter
rows.abstract:
Provides for the following: 1.) Attach the Philippine Deposit Insurance Corporation (PDIC) to the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) for policy and program coordination; 2.) Modify certain powers of PDIC to exercise its core mandates as deposit insurer and liquidator of banks;
3.) Authorize the Board of Directors to increase the maximum deposit coverage when financial stability is threatened; 4.) Provide PDIC the authority to setup deposit insurance schemes for protection of users of new financial products, and depositors in Islamic banks; 5.) Provide that the compensation of PDIC officials shall be based on the Compensation and Position Classification System (CPCS) of the Governance Commission on Government-Owned-and-Controlled Corporations, among others.

rows.title_short: Changing The Term Of Office Of Barangay Officials And Members Of The Sangguniang Kabataan From Three (3) To Five (5) Years, And Providing For Limitations On Their Recall, Amending For The Purpose Sections 43(c) And 74 Of Republic Act No.7160, As Amended, Otherwise Known As The Local Government Code
rows.abstract:
Seeks to change the term of office of barangay officials and members of the Sangguniang Kabataan from three (3) years to five (5) years which shall begin after the regular election of barangays officials on December 5, 2022.

Provides that the next regular election of barangay officials shall be held on the second Monday of May 2027 and every five (5) years thereafter.

Provides that no recall of any elective barangay official shall take place within two (2) years from the date of the official´s assumption to office or two (2) years immediately preceding a regular or local election.

rows.author: H023
rows.title_full:
AN ACT REGULATING THE PRACTICE OF MICROBIOLOGY 
IN THE PHILIPPINES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Philippine Microbiology Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to institute a regulatory system that guarantees the delivery of technical services in a manner that ensures food safety and high quality of manufactured goods, prevents the rapid spread of microbially-caused diseases in human, plant, and animal populations, and helps provide a safe and healthy environment for the general populace.

Also aims to develop and nature competent, ethical, globally competitive and well-rounded professionals who shall observe the highest standard of excellence through credible and relevant licensure examination.

Creates the Professional Regulatory Board for Microbiology which shall promulgates, administer and enforce rules and regulations of the practice of microbiology in the country. 

Allows holders of Master´s or Doctoral Degree in Microbiology or related fields from an HEI to apply for exemption as microbiologist without examination from the Board provided they have actively practiced the microbiology professional for at least five (5) years.

Allows issuance of temporary permit to foreign registered or licensed microbiologist to practice microbiology in the Philippines under certain conditions.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2021-03-15, transmitted to the Senate on 2021-03-16 and received by the Senate on 2021-03-16
